subject: maths
question: A car covers a distance of 40 km in 24 minutes. If its speed is decreased by 40 km/hr, then what will be the time taken by it to cover the same distance?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial Speed = 40 ÷ (24/60) = 100 km/hr.

New Speed = 100 − 40 = 60 km/hr.

New Time = 40 ÷ 60 hours = (40 ÷ 60) × 60 minutes.

New Time = 40 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70bc0e4e249c09d59a1b6311e802d7411a41b85aa8b7e492be09784d4849e447.png] 

**Given:**

Distance = 40 km

Initial time = 24 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Initial time in hours = 24 ÷ 60 = 2/5 hours

⇒ Initial speed = 40 ÷ (2/5) = 100 km/hr

⇒ Decreased speed = 100 − 40 = 60 km/hr

⇒ New time taken = Distance ÷ New speed

⇒ New time = 40 ÷ 60 hours

⇒ New time in minutes = (40 ÷ 60) × 60 = 40 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 40 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the speed by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If the distance covered is equal in both parts of the journey, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. When moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.
